Madison Beer (Debut)
Madison Beer

Description
Madison Beer's original debut album was intended to be released around the periods of 2014 and 2015. It is thought to have been written and recorded from 2013 to 2015, back when Madison was still working with her former label Island Records. The album possibly went through many sound/concept changes throughout its making, before getting immediately scrapped after Island Records terminated Madison's contract in mid 2015.
(description from here)

This is just a concept by me and is not an offical release whatsoever. The artwork was made by me. All the songs featured here were made during her time with Island Records. The tracklist was orderd by me.
